scenario: A precision of exactly 20 on `f` is admitted per LGRA.2.9.6.5, whose bound is inclusive. Pin: `{t.v:.20f}` on a Float slot passes `dsc.validate.lgra_2_9_6_5_refusals`'s precision-above-20 rule, the boundary twin of LGRA.2.9.6.5g at 21; an off-by-one written `>= 20` refuses this fixture. compile_ok pins acceptance only.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key
    v: Float mutable

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    log info "v: {t.v:.20f}"
